resource_accounting.reporting_rule: Use the stage-process receipt totals as full process accounting; the inner values are retained only for provenance.

experiment1.accepted_interpretation: In the frozen iid toy model, hard minimum selection changes the small-step behavior from the weighted arm, with approximately h^0.5 versus h scaling in the tested cells.
experiment1.interpretation_boundary: Matching h scaling does not prove that likelihood-weighted selection has the correct posterior dynamics, and the iid result is not a theorem for native NP with incumbent reuse.

metric_definitions.posterior_tv: total-variation error to the exact finite-support posterior; lower is better
metric_definitions.truth_mse: empirical reconstruction MSE to the single frozen truth; lower is better and is not a posterior-fidelity metric

K8_all_prior_families.interpretation: This family prevents any claim that exact-intermediate weighting universally wins.

The hard-selection result is descriptive only: theoretically identical likelihoods differ at floating-point precision, and hard argmax/argmin can turn the difference into a systematic preference. Exclude this row from evidence for an intrinsic hard-selection defect until tie handling is examined.
Exact-intermediate weighting is much closer to the target posterior, while hard selection has lower error to the single frozen truth.

experiment2.accepted_interpretation: The near-ambiguity families support a conditional-inference hypothesis that intermediate-likelihood estimation can improve posterior fidelity. They do not demonstrate improved reconstruction of a single ground truth or improved FFHQ PSNR.
experiment2.next_estimator_boundary: A toy exact likelihood does not provide an implementable pretrained-model intermediate-likelihood estimator. Any next stage must specify the estimator, proposal distribution, finite-proposal approximation, lineage handling, and full compute cost before FFHQ execution.

NP.label_boundary: 57/80 is the four-candidate oracle, not historical clean-free NP selection.

experiment3.accepted_interpretation: The tested eight channelwise reversal transformations do not explain the frozen common DAPS4/SITCOM4 failure subset.
experiment3.interpretation_boundary: This conclusion is restricted to the tested transformations and does not rule out every possible phase-retrieval ambiguity or symmetry.

verified_semantics.DAPS_main: nonnegative FFT-magnitude prediction with squared Gaussian residual against the supplied signed measurement
verified_semantics.DAPS_B20_auxiliary_LF_projection: uses abs(measurement) only inside the auxiliary amplitude projection
verified_semantics.SITCOM_main: nonnegative FFT-magnitude prediction with squared Gaussian residual against the supplied signed measurement
verified_semantics.NP_B24_DEV80: verifies the locked raw measurement, then uses measurement_raw.clamp_min(0.0) in the NP path

experiment4.accepted_interpretation: NP measurement preprocessing materially changes all 80 stored observations and deserves an isolated correction ablation.
experiment4.interpretation_boundary: The preprocessing discrepancy does not establish an effect on reconstruction quality and does not prove clipping caused a historical failure.

final_recommendation_category: a precisely defined NP conditional-selection correction
final_recommendation_interpretation: one focused NP conditional-selection investigation at fixed computational budget; not a validated reconstruction method
next_scientific_question: Can we estimate the intermediate conditional likelihood well enough to improve reconstruction at a fixed computational budget?
